hero.title: Electrical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A degree in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius is an undergraduate course for students who want to study electrical power systems, electronics, industrial automation, renewable energy and electrical equipment. Related undergraduate degrees can be found in Mauritius, including BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering at the University of Mauritius and BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technology at Université des Mascareignes. These options make **Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** a course worth exploring.

overview: Students who want to acquire technical knowledge and build a career in electrical and industrial engineering have good options in these programs. With guidance from **Edu-Hawk Worldwide**, students can compare programs and understand the process to **Study Electrical Engineering in Mauritius**.

faq.question: How long does it take to get a Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius runs a 4 year full-time BEng (Hons) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. Université des Mascareignes also offers a 4 year BEng program in Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technology.

faq.question: What universities in Mauritius offer electrical engineering?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius and Université des Mascareignes provide relevant undergraduate courses. The latter also runs a separate program in Electrical Engineering and Automation. These are among the Electrical Engineering Universities in Mauritius that students can explore.

faq.question: What are eligibility criteria for Indian students?
faq.answer: Applicants usually need to have a Class 12 or equivalent qualification with appropriate mathematics and science subjects. The precise combinations of subjects and the grade requirements depend on the program and university selected. Students should verify the Electrical Engineering Eligibility in Mauritius with their chosen institution.

faq.question: How much is the cost of studying Electrical Engineering in Mauritius in INR?
faq.answer: Université des Mascareignes has a non-SADC international fee category of MUR 84,000 per year, which is roughly around ₹1.60 lakh at the illustrative conversion used here. The estimated living costs may total an estimated ₹4.67–₹8.89 lakh per year. Please check the tuition for your particular course before applying. The Electrical Engineering Fees in Mauritius may vary depending on the university and program.

faq.question: What jobs can I get after studying Electrical Engineering?
faq.answer: Graduates may be interested in positions in electrical design, power systems, automation, control systems, maintenance, electronics, renewable energy and instrumentation. Your career options will be influenced by the degree, practical skills, experience and local employment requirements. Edu-Hawk Worldwide can guide students in exploring study options, understanding admission procedures and preparing for their international education journey.
